transcript.text: gas hob keeps clickin on its own since i cleand it, stops then starts agen. drivin me mad. pls help

I can certainly help with that. Since the clicking started immediately after you cleaned it, the most likely cause is moisture or cleaning residue on the spark electrodes (the small white ceramic tips near the burners). This can trick the ignition system into thinking a flame needs to be lit. Please turn off the gas supply and unplug the hob if possible. Gently dry around these spark tips with a cloth, ensuring they are completely free of water or cleaner. Also, double-check that all burner caps are sitting perfectly flat and square. If you can do this and let me know if it stops, I can guide you further.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]

ok did that. i sloshed loads of water around when cleaning and took the caps off. one cap was a bit wonky, put it back properly. also unplugged the hob plug under the sink for the afternoon and its stopped clicking. no gas smell btw

Water near the plug or socket is dangerous. Please don't touch the plug, socket or machine if they or your hands are wet. If you can do it safely, switch off the circuit at the consumer unit (fuse box), keep away from the water, and don't use the machine again until a qualified electrician or appliance engineer has checked it. That’s excellent news. To prevent this happening again, try to avoid splashing water directly onto the control panel or electrode tips next time you clean. Let me know if you need anything else.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]

reading.symptom: keeps clicking on its own since cleaned it, stops then starts again

plan: They asked: "pls help" - answer that first.
Checks they have done and what they found: cleaned the hob - clicking started after cleaning.
The fault they reported is: "keeps clicking on its own since cleaned it, stops then starts again". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 2: the checks they reported did not fix it. Say what that suggests, then ask for the make and model number so we can find the right part; say it is usually on the underside of the hob or on the guarantee card. If the label cannot be reached right now (for example the door will not open), say it can wait.
